title: AzUniswap
tagline: Perform private and cheap swap on Uniswap through aztec bridge

description: AzUniswap enables users to perform private and cheap swap on Uniswap through aztec bridge without sacrificing liquidity on Uniswap Etherum Mainnet. It will be useful for users, who want to make large amount of token swap, but are afraid of large slippage and front run by other traders.
how_its_made: AzUniswap mainly use Aztec bridge as a layer 2 solution to perform swap at Uniswap on Ethereum  Mainnet. Unlike other layer 2 solutions, like Optimistic and Arbitrum, Aztec can reuse existing liquidity on Uniswap Etheruem Mainnet.  Moreover, Aztec can hide users' identity, so Aztec swap can be performed privately.
